Gentle, Breast-Friendly Pumping
Baby mouth-like suction rhythm, skin-friendly silicone, and 30-minute auto stop help make daily pumping feel gentler and more comfortable.
Patented DoubleFit™ Flange for a Better Fit
The exclusive DoubleFit™ flange is made to fit more securely and comfortably, helping reduce slips and tugs while boosting pumping efficiency by 28.2% based on internal user feedback.
Ultra-Light, Hands-Free Freedom
Weighing only 8 oz, M5 Smart fits comfortably in your bra for cord-free, hands-free pumping—so you can move, work, care for baby, or get more done while you pump.
Personalized Pumping with Flexible Suction
With 3 pumping modes and 9 suction levels, M5 Smart lets you adjust each session to your body’s needs, supporting comfortable and efficient milk expression.
Made with BPA-free, food-grade silicone and PP, M5 Smart keeps cleanup simple with only 4 washable parts. Parts can be sterilized in 3 minutes and are heat safe up to 212°F.
Easier Control from Your Phone
Use the Momcozy app to adjust modes and suction levels, track milk output, and view visual pumping stats by day, week, or month—giving you easier control without reaching into your bra.

How do I connect M5 Smart to the app?
Open the Momcozy App and make sure Bluetooth is enabled.
Tap Add Device, select M5 Smart, or scan the QR code on the pump.
Once connected, you’ll see the control page.
Can I control both pumps at the same time?
Yes. The app supports dual control , so you can adjust both pumps together with one tap.
You can also switch between left / right pump control and set different modes or suction levels for each side.
Can I connect M5 Smart to multiple phones?
For the best experience, connect to one phone at a time.
If you want to switch phones, disconnect from the current device first and pair again on the new phone.
Can I use M5 Smart without the app?
Yes. The Momcozy App is optional—M5 Smart can also be used directly with the pump controls.
What can I control in the app?
Once connected, you can start/stop pumping, switch modes, adjust suction levels, and check key pump status (such as battery level) right from the Momcozy App .
What kind of pumping stats can I view in the app?
The app can show a clear overview of your pumping records, including:
Daily / weekly / monthly summaries
Total logged output (based on manual entries)
Session frequency and duration
What's the difference between M5 Smart and M5?
M5 Smart is an upgraded vers

ion of M5 with app control and longer battery life.
You can adjust modes and suction levels right from your phone—no need to reach into your bra or fumble with buttons during a session. The app also helps you log milk output and pumping sessions, so you can stay organized and track your routine more easily.
M5 Smart also lasts longer (up to 180 mins vs. 150 mins), while keeping the same compact, fully in-bra design.
Why is pumping with M5 Smart more comfortable than other pumps?
M5 Smart is made to feel gentler and easier to wear. The DoubleFit™ flange and baby mouth-like suction rhythm help create a softer, more natural-feeling pumping experience. With 30-minute auto stop and an 8 oz ultra-light design, it’s more comfortable for everyday pumping—at home, at work, or on the go.
